topic: Defining a Custom Structure for Thread Data in C
explanation: A custom structure in C is a user-defined data type that groups related variables together under a single name. It is used to organize and pass multiple pieces of data efficiently, which is particularly helpful in thread synchronization to share or transfer data between threads without global variables, promoting better code modularity and avoiding errors.
